posts.title: A Decade of Kill Bugs
posts.description: On the morning of September 24th 2026, Endcrawl had a brief outage. I'd just typed: sudo kill -TERM -1490947 And instantly all services went down. Right away I blamed myself. Maybe I mistyped that number! Maybe my code had a signal handling bug. Maybe I don't understand Unix as well as I think I do. Maybe I'm an idiot!
